command: Human LPIN3 (Q9BQK8) has transcription coactivator activity, promotes RNA polymerase II transcription, participates in fatty acid catabolism, or responds to insulin. Evaluate these independently from its established phosphatidate phosphatase activity. Compare lipin paralogs, relevant conserved binding interfaces, experimental gene identity and context, and the actual ancestral assignments. Distinguish a lack of LPIN3-specific testing from target-specific divergence or direct negative experiments.
